description: Explain the evidence, risk, testability, and recommendation for one target in an existing audit/v1 artifact. Use this after audit_repo or audit_projects when one target needs detail beyond the audit summary. Returns target-explanation/v1 without rescanning the repository, executing tests, or writing files.

audit.description: The audit/v1 object returned by audit_repo or contained in projectAudits.audits[].audit; pass the artifact itself, not a file path.

targetId.description: Exact stable id from an audit target in untestedCandidates, coveredButRisky, recommended, or skipped.

name: explain_target

outputSchema.description: Top-level shape of this artifact. The complete contract is schemas/target-explanation-v1.schema.json in the published package.

title: Explain Audit Target
